summary: A central US lookouts listing and a trip report describe an existing fire lookout on Buffalo Mountain; TopoQuest places a same-named summit in Pittsburg County.

facts.status: reported existing in an undated trip report

evidence.supports: listing places the tower in Latimer County under the Oklahoma Forestry Service
trip report calls Buffalo Mountain a county high point and an existing fire lookout site
evidence.quote: Buffalo Mountain, which is a CoHP, P1K, and existing fire lookout site.

evidence.supports: trip began eastward out of Oklahoma City, with Buffalo Mountain as first stop
evidence.quote: We left OKC early on Saturday morning, heading east.

evidence.supports: trip was an Easter-weekend loop of high points
TopoQuest places a Buffalo Mountain summit in Pittsburg County
evidence.quote: Buffalo Mountain is a summit located in Pittsburg County, OK

evidence.supports: Buffalo Mountain was the first stop of the trip
evidence.quote: Our first stop was Buffalo Mountain

sources.title: Oklahoma-Arkansas Highpointing on Easter Weekend (trip report)

notes_for_editor: County conflict: the central US listing says Latimer County; TopoQuest places a Buffalo Mountain summit in Pittsburg County at 984 ft MSL, coordinates N34.964820 W95.531926, well away from the record point 34.7539, -95.1771. The only description of the lookout is a trip report with no date in the text we read. No build date, design, height or staffing found. Check the USGS 1:24K Adamson, OK map and Oklahoma Forestry Services records before relying on either location. No corrections proposed; the conflict is unresolved.
